newsitem.title: USA: Admor sees fiscal '97 revs at $31 mln.
newsitem.headline: Admor sees fiscal '97 revs at $31 mln.

text.p: Admor Memory Corp Wednesday estimated revenues of $10 million in its fiscal fourth quarter ended June 30, boosting fiscal year total revenues to $31 million versus $10.9 million one year ago.
Admor, a maker of add-on computer memory, expects to report fourth quarter and fiscal year earnings by September 1, it said in a statement.

"Based on discussion among management and our top sales personnel, we believe revenues nearing $70 million for fiscal year 1998 are achievable provided we obtain sufficient funding throughout the year," Chief Executive Michael Rapp said.
"Further, with the advent of in-house manufacturing, increased operational efficiencies, and efforts to trim our costs, we are encouraged about positive earnings potential as well," Rapp added.
He said the company met its fiscal 1997 internal goals and is focused on how to achieve a better performance in fiscal 1998.
